render_attempts.prompt_text: Paint a monumental HUMAN-LED narrative WALL FRESCO, not an architectural visualization. The first thing the viewer sees is a large Janus-like guardian or paired elder-and-youth figure at the center mediating between celestial and human registers. This central human or human-led group occupies roughly one quarter of the composition and has expressive faces and gestures. Around it place about 18 additional human figures in at least 5 distinct groups. Show four clearly readable secondary episodes: observers study the heavens from an upper gallery; citizens gather in quiet counsel below; messengers descend between the upper and middle registers; teachers guide children in the intimate lower register. Paint it as a museum-scale monumental allegorical wall fresco, old-master figure painting, Renaissance and neoclassical grandeur, antique engraving-level detail, visibly painted on weathered lime plaster, cracked pigment, worn gilding, deep ultramarine, old gold, ivory stone, ochre, sepia and restrained crimson. Dense micro-scenes, layered human reactions, natural anatomy, coherent perspective, deep blue and old gold accents, worn mineral pigment, cracked plaster and intricate old-master line detail.

role_audit.label: human_summary_ru
role_audit.value: Суть движка: Янус не должен начинать работу с нуля только потому, что задача впервые появилась перед ним. Сначала он ищет, кто уже занимался тем же или соседним вопросом — внутри собственных репозиториев и снаружи. Затем проверяет найденное, отделяет общие строительные блоки и идеи от конкретной реализации, выясняет, что действительно решено и где находится открытый край задачи. Всё проверенное и допустимое к повторному использованию становится стартовой площадкой. Новые ресурсы тратятся на нерешённое, улучшение или проверяемый синтез нескольких механизмов. Похожесть не равна плагиату, но найденная похожесть также не даёт права копировать чужую конкретную реализацию.

role_audit.label: purpose.long
role_audit.value: This engine converts prior-art discovery from a novelty-policing step into a progress accelerator. JANUS should first ask whether the problem, mechanism, algorithm, architecture, pattern or partial solution already exists internally or externally. It then separates common building blocks and general ideas from specific expressions and implementations, verifies what is actually solved, preserves provenance and licensing boundaries, identifies the strongest relevant frontier, and spends new effort on the unsolved remainder or on a genuinely new interaction between existing mechanisms.

semantic_facts.label: purpose.long
semantic_facts.value: This engine converts prior-art discovery from a novelty-policing step into a progress accelerator. JANUS should first ask whether the problem, mechanism, algorithm, architecture, pattern or partial solution already exists internally or externally. It then separates common building blocks and general ideas from specific expressions and implementations, verifies what is actually solved, preserves provenance and licensing boundaries, identifies the strongest relevant frontier, and spends new effort on the unsolved remainder or on a genuinely new interaction between existing mechanisms.
